consistency_rules: is_hazard is true if and only if risk_level is L2 or L3
unknown taxonomy uses other plus proposed_event_type
no-event windows have an empty event list
reviewers choose only visible frame indices
disagreement_resolution: A third blinded adjudicator reviews disagreements without seeing VLM outputs or reviewer identities.
ground_truth_claim: Only the adjudicated sampled windows may be called human reference; unreviewed VLM outputs remain pseudo-reference.
